25375.description:
Company :
Hastings Deering (PNG) Limited
About Us:
Hastings Deering (PNG) Limited is one of the largest Caterpillar dealer networks in the world. We sell, service and support the complete range of Caterpillar machinery used in the mining, construction, agricultural, materials handling and government sectors. Over the last 75 years, we have built a reputation for hiring and developing the industry’s best and delivering an exemplary level of service to our customers and colleagues.
About the Role:
We currently have an excellent opportunity for a
Safety Advisor
join our Safety Department team based in Port Moresby.
This role primarily exists coordinate all aspects of OHS at Business Centre/Site level, ensuring continuing compliance with Company standards and current legislation and regulation.
Reporting to the
Safety Superintendent, PNG & Solomon Island,
your competency, and experience will include:
Ensure safety goals are achieved through personal commitment, no harm to self or others and participation in safety initiatives.
Ensure business direction, team purpose, and change agenda is understood, agreed to and work activities are aligned.
Proactively seek and maintain collaborative relationships with peers and manager to deliver results.
Provide advice and assistance to facilitate a safe working environment and ensure that all work practices are in accordance with Company policy and recognized and legislated OH&S regulations and procedures.
Coordinate accident/incident investigation, reporting and corrective actions.
Coordinate Workplace Rehabilitation Program for injured employees to ensure best recovery and premium minimization.
Ensure environmental policies and procedures are adhered to.
Assist in the inductions and training of employees in compliance with site and Company requirements and legislation and record and maintain in appropriate registers and report.
About You:
Must have Grade 12 school certificate.
Certificate IV in Workplace Health and Safety
Certificate IV in Workplace Training and Assessment or National Certificate 2 in Training and Assessment
Workplace Rehabilitation Coordinator qualifications
ICAM or recognized root cause analyses qualifications.
Minimum three years’ experience in a similar role.
Previous exposure to mining/heavy equipment industries and the legislation and regulations they operate within.
Incident investigation and reporting experience.
Experience in undertaking safety incident investigations with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
“Only Port Moresby based candidates are required to apply.”
To express interest for this challenging and rewarding role, submit your application including current updated CV, copies of certificates, references, police clearance and apply via Workday Career page.
Applications without valid Police Clearance Certificates will not be considered.
To Apply: Click on the “Apply”
button.
Enquiries: Please call our HR Team on (675) 300 8300
Only Shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
Applications close Friday 19th December 2025
Apply

25348.description:
Job Title:
Inventory Manager
Company: MATERIAL TESTING INDUSTRIAL SUPPLIES (MTIS) PNG LTD
Are you highly organized and experienced Inventory professional with a passion for precision and optimization? Do you thrive in a dynamic warehouse environment and possess a keen eye for detail? MTIS PNG is seeking a dedicated and proactive
Inventory Manager
to join our team in Port Moresby, Papua New Guinea.
The role will be critical ensuring the security, accuracy, and efficiency of our inventory warehouse operation, and will directly contribute to our operational success.
About the Role:
Reporting to the Technical Operations Manager, the Inventory Manager is the cornerstone of our warehouse inventory operations. You will be responsible for developing and implementing robust inventory control policies, meticulously managing our ERP system, and leading a team to maintain the highest standards of inventory accuracy and compliance. This is an exciting opportunity to make a tangible impact by optimising stock levels, minimizing obsolescence, and enhancing overall warehouse efficiency.
Key Responsibilities:
Developing and implementing comprehensive inventory control strategies and procedures.
Overseeing and enforcing stringent security protocols for all warehouse inventory.
Managing and maintaining the ERP system for all inventory data, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
Conducting regular inventory audits and cycle counts, reconciling discrepancies.
Coordinating closely with Purchasing for optimal stock replenishment.
Managing aged and obsolete inventory in line with company policy.
Ensuring strict compliance with safety regulations and maintaining exceptional housekeeping standards.
Training,supervising,and mentoring Warehouse Officers and Assistants.
Generating insightful inventory reports for senior management.
What We’re Looking For:
Education
: Ideally a Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.
Experience:
Minimum 5-7 years in inventory management, or warehouse operations.
At least 3 years in a leadership or supervisory inventory role.
Proven expertise in ERP systems for inventory control is essential.
Strong analytical skills for demand forecasting and optimization.
Experience with physical inventory audits and cycle counting.
Skills:
Exceptional organizational skills and meticulous attention to details.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Effective leadership and team development skills.
Proficiency in inventory management software and Microsoft Suit (especially Excel).
Solid understanding of warehousing safety and best practices.
Good communication skills.
Why Join MTIS PNG?
We offer a collaborative work environment.
Opportunities for professional growth and development.
Competitive salary and benefits.
Be part of a growing company making a difference.
If you are a driven and detail-oriented professional ready to take on a pivotal role in a thriving organization, we encourage you to apply!
Location:
111 Napa Napa Rd, Motukea, Port Moresby.
Transport provided to and from work via a pick up point.
How to Apply:
Qualified candidates are invited to submit their CV and cover letter in one document, PDF format detailing their relevant experience to
[email protected]
. Please reference "
Inventory Manag
er" in the subject line of your email.
MTIS Group is an equal opportunity employer. We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.
Closing date of Application:
Thursday, 18 December,2025
Join MTIS PNG Limited and make a positive impact in the industry while advancing your career!
Apply

25336.description:
PNG Air, renowned for its extensive network covering over 26 destinations throughout Papua New Guinea, operates the largest fleet of ATR 72-600 series aircraft in the region. As the Airline of Choice, we're committed to delivering a world-class experience with competitive fares, unparalleled cargo rates, and a focus on safety and on-time performance for our valued customers and stakeholders.
ACCOUNTS PAYABLE SUPERVISOR
We are pleased to announce an open vacancy now exists in our Finance Department for a qualified and experienced Accounts Payable Supervisor.
Based in Port Moresby this position will report to Accounts Payable Manager. This role will coordinate, lead and supervise the effective management of all company’s creditor’s accounts and related duties in accordance with the company’s operational and business requirements, providing the required support to the Accounts Payable Manager, to meet all line departments/divisions operational and administrative needs.
The AP Supervisor will be responsible for the following key responsibilities:
Co-ordinate with relevant departments/divisions to ensure a smooth transition/flow of documents between them and the finance/accounts payable section
Ensure correct procedures (SOP) are followed before any request for payment is done
Task to complete monthly reports within the set dead line as required
Checking and posting of creditors data entry batches and payment
Review of creditor’s reconciliations, statement of account versus the creditors’ age payable listing
Liaising with other department/division regarding queries
Preparation of ad hoc reports as required by the Accounts Payable Manager and or the Manager-Financial Planning & Analysis
Provide training to junior level staff
Other duties as assigned as requested by Finance Management team
QUALIFICATION/EXPERIENCE
Tertiary qualified with an appropriate Accounting back ground.
Experience in Accounts Payable functions and processes.
Display a sound understanding of Accounts Payables objectives and plans including operating systems used in the aviation industry.
The ability to proactively provide supervision employing systems and processes and procedures and to operate effectively meeting the Accounts Payables requirements.
Ability to provide guidance to the junior level staff within Accounts Payable.
Be hard working, trustworthy and results oriented/focused.
Proficient in MS Software (MS Word, MS Excel).
Knowledgeable in Accpac Software (desirable but not required)
3 years experiences supervising an AP team.
If you feel you meet our requirements and are interested, we would like to hear from you. Send your application in only one PDF file to:
[email protected]
Applications close:
Friday 19
th
December 2025
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted
We are an equal opportunity employer.
Apply

Strong knowledge of pharmacology, therapeutics, and drug legislation.
Excellent communication, problem-solving, and attention to detail.
Ability to work under pressure and maintain high accuracy standards.
Proficiency in pharmacy information systems and record-keeping.

25273.description:
Join the Application Support Team
Are you passionate about technology and problem-solving?  We’re looking for experienced people to keep our core business applications running smoothly and support our users every day.
Application Support Technician (with 1-3 years’ experience)
Application Support Officers (with 5-10 years’ experience)
What You’ll Do
Monitor & Maintain Applications
– Perform daily checks, backups, and clean-ups to prevent issues.
User Support
– Respond to tickets, troubleshoot application problems, and escalate complex cases when needed.
Access & Documentation
– Manage user permissions and maintain accurate records of incidents and changes.
Data & Reporting
– Run scheduled reports, validate data, and coordinate corrections.
Updates & Testing
– Assist with testing and rolling out application updates.
Training & Guides
– Create simple how-to documents and share tips to help users work smarter.
What We’re Looking For
Qualifications:
Certificate in IT or equivalent experience.
Basic SQL skills (queries, backups/restores, error logs).
Ability to install, configure, and troubleshoot business applications.
Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, XLOOKUP, Power Query).
Familiarity with scripting (PowerShell/VBA/Python) for small automations.
Skills & Abilities:
Good planning, organizational, and communication skills.
Confident, efficient, and self-motivated with a flexible attitude.
Work Environment

25240.description:
Job Type:
Permanent
About us
K92 Mining Limited are the owners the high-grade Kainantu Gold Mine in Eastern Highlands Province. Since commencing operations in 2016, we have delivered consistent production growth. More importantly, we have contributed significantly to the economy of Papua New Guinea, more than 90% of our employees and contractors are from PNG and our local education and skills development initiatives which include scholarships, traineeships and adult literacy programs continue to bring significant benefit the communities in which we operate.
We are now transforming the operation with a new 1.2 mtpa process plant as well as extensive construction and expansion across site that will see us triple the output from our mine by 2027. In addition to our ongoing production success, we have an extensive exploration programme across our highly prospective tenement, making K92 a great place to build a long-term career.
About the role
Joining our growing mine site, the Senior IT Officer will ensure all IT systems, equipment, and services at the mine are set up, maintained, and secure. This role supports the team by solving IT issues onsite, guiding and coaching junior staff and technicians, and ensuring all work follows company IT and Communications policies.
The Senior IT Officer also helps with the installation and support of hardware and software, provides administration support, and keeps safety and health as top priorities. This role is key in making sure the mine can operate smoothly and safely with reliable technology.
Key Accountabilities
Key accountabilities of this position include
Oversee the day-to-day running of IT systems and services across the site.
Provide technical support and guidance to users, addressing IT issues and requests.
Lead and support the setup, maintenance, and improvement of computers, servers, networks, and communication equipment.
Coordinate and deliver IT projects and upgrades as needed.
Ensure regular maintenance, monitoring, and backup of IT systems and data.
Work with business applications and provide administration support.
Ensure IT systems and practices remain secure, up to date, and aligned with company policies.
Train and support staff in using IT systems and following best practices.
Guide, mentor, and provide leadership to junior IT staff and technicians.
Collaborate with external IT vendors and partners as required.
Support safety standards and company values in all IT activities.
Maintain clear documentation and records.
Take part in IT planning and budgeting for the site.
Review and recommend improvements to current IT processes and systems.
Support audits and compliance activities related to IT.
Assist with asset management of IT equipment and resources.
Communicate updates and changes in IT systems or processes to all relevant staff.
About You
To be considered for this role, it is essential that you must have a Diploma or Tertiary qualification in IT with a minimum of 2 years work experience in IT roles in extractive industry (mining preferred). In addition to this, you will have some or all the following.
Good understanding of IT and Communications Systems, both hardware and software.
Able to explain technical ideas simply, both in writing and speaking.
Good organisational and problem-solving skills.
Ability to coach, mentor, and support junior IT staff and technicians.
Additional training or certificates in IT, business analysis, project management, or IT security.
Knowledge of best practices for IT security and data protection.
Life at K92
K92 is an Equal Opportunity Employer, our commitment is to respect the rights of every individual to work to their highest potential, free from discrimination.  Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Respect for others, Excellence and Safety are at the core of everything we do, and they are the foundation upon which our success has been built.
Our camp is well managed and provides residents with good, healthy meals made from locally sourced fresh produce as well as internet, cable tv and a gymnasium.
At K92, we want all employees to share in our success, so as well as a competitive salary, employees also participate in our long- and short-term incentive plans, we also provide employees with access to savings incentive programs, medical assistance and the option to salary sacrifice for certain expenses.
In addition to all of this, employees can also access our Wellbeing and employee assistance programs whilst working a friendly roster.
THIS POSITION IS OPEN ONLY TO CANDIDATES WHO HAVE THE RIGHT TO LIVE & WORK IN PNG WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP
Apply

PLEASE NOTE THAT THIS POSITION IS FOR A TUTOR TO BE BASED IN BALIMO COLLEGE CAMPUS IN WESTERN PROVINCE, PNG. BEFORE APPLYING, PLEASE ENSURE THAT YOU HAVE THE RELEVANT NURSING AND ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE, AND THE ABILITY TO RELOCATE TO WESTERN PROVINCE
ORGANISATION:
Balimo College
POSITION:

LOCATION:
Balimo, Western Province
COMMENCEMENT:
January 2026
DURATION:
12-month contract with a 3-month probationary period
REMUNERATION:
Competitive remuneration package offered
REPORTING TO:
Deputy Principal- Balimo College School of Nursing
ABOUT BALIMO COLLEGE:
Balimo College is Western Province’s newest Higher Education Institute. In 2025, Balimo College opened the new School of Nursing and commenced a 4-year Bachelor of General Nursing program. The College’s vision is to advance Western Province by providing high-quality education, research and community engagement. The institute will foster pathways for teachers and nurses who are committed to improving access to vital services in Western Province.
Balimo College is a safe and supportive place for graduates and other professionals across the Western Province catchment region to return for life-long learning and ongoing professional development. The College will develop a community of education and health professionals committed to innovation, excellence and community advancement; by being the training College of choice for Papua New Guineans.
Balimo College is a PNG Sustainable Development Program (SDP) initiative delivered in partnership with KTF, Divine Word University, and Western Sydney University. Balimo College School of Nursing is an affiliate of Divine Word University.
ABOUT THE ROLE:
The Balimo College School of Nursing Tutor is responsible for supporting the Principal and Lecturers of the College to uphold the College’s Vision, Mission, Core Values, Educational Philosophy and Goals. The Tutor will operate within the Balimo College School of Nursing faculty as determined by the Principal through the Governing Council, to disseminate strong, effective educational support to support students within the parameters identified in this position description.
The Tutor will have an in-depth knowledge of the ethos and purpose of the Balimo College School of Nursing and the principles by which it operates. The Tutor will have a firm understanding of the Western Province education context and the objectives of Balimo College School of Nursing to create pathways for rural communities into the field of nursing.
KEY SELECTION CRITERIA
Applicants must demonstrate that they are able to meet the following Key Selection Criteria:
Bachelor’s degree in nursing.
Experience in Midwifery, Paediatrics, Acute Care, or Mental Health
Minimum 3 years of teaching experience.
Strong clinical skills and experience.
Excellent interpersonal, oral and written communication skills.
Be willing to relocate to Balimo College campus.
Applicants must have the right to work in PNG.
Knowledge of:
A range of educational theories, techniques, and methodologies of personnel and management.
Principles and practices of supervision.
PNG Nursing Council Standards.
Bachelor of Nursing Curriculum.
DHERST requirements for a School of Nursing.
Ability to:
Provide support, direction and motivation to students.
Communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, with staff and students.
Interpret, apply, and explain rules, regulations, policies and procedures to students and parents.
Establish and maintain cooperative and effective working relationships with others.
Operate a computer to a good level of competence.
Analyse situations accurately in a classroom context and support an effective course of actions.
Support timelines for the academic delivery of curriculum, mentoring and assessments.
Plan, organise and prioritise work.
Personal Skills & Attributes:
Strong health background.
Care for young people.
Intellectual capacity.
Proven ability to lead and work with teams.
Relational style which commands loyalty.
Problem solving ability.
Multi-tasking capability.
Strong interest in current educational trends.
High administrative ability.
Strong sense of justice.
Ability to confront difficult situations.
Resilience and energy.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
The Tutor is responsible for:
Upholding and supporting the Principal and teaching team in delivering the vision for the Balimo College School of Nursing.
Exercising discernment and care in assisting the Principal and teaching team with supporting staff, students, and parents.
Supporting the development and empowerment of the teaching staff that will cultivate and strengthen a positive teaching, learning, and working environment for all staff and students at every level of operations.
Supporting the Principal and lecturers with clinical education and support with for Balimo College School of Nursing
Vision, Mission and Culture
Uphold and lead others to the realisation of the Mission, Vision, Values, Educational Philosophy and Goals of the Balimo College School of Nursing in all operations.
Be able to hold a vision for the College and support others to the realisation of that vision.
Understand and maintain a College culture that will characterise the College as a place of care, academic excellence, transparency and integrity, accountability, and commitment to community.
Manage and advocate a strong collaborative service culture within the College and local community.
Administration
Be familiar with College administration procedures.
Attend all faculty meetings and record details if required by the principal for wider circulation to staff.
Be familiar with the Balimo College School of Nursing calendar and attend all calendared meetings and lectures in a timely manner.
Ensure personal full compliance of the College rules and behavioural expectations for yourself and your students.
Delivery of clinical support for the curriculum.
Monitor and record student’s information clearly, coherently and confidentially for the identification and conducting of learner assessments.
Alert the Principal to any maintenance requirements or any issues of Occupational Health and Safety Policy and Procedures on site.
Teaching & Learning
Actively and pro-actively support the lecturers to enhance the quality of teaching and learning.
Support the lecturers in tutorials and clinical placements.
Support the use of ICT and of developments in Digital Learning Technologies and actively support the students to enable their studies with the support of ICT.
Engage in the support needed to utilise technology for implementation in the classroom.
Support the Principal and lecturers with the delivery and moderation of assessment and reporting across whole staff cohort.
Support the Principal and lecturers with the delivery and management of the practicum component of the curriculum
Professional Development
Regularly attend Professional Development Training to keep abreast of current trends in nursing education;
Attend and be actively engaged in appropriate Professional Development;
Keep up to date with current educational thought and practice;
Support the Principal and lecturers to implement the Balimo College School of Nursing Professional Learning and Development Policy where it aligns to your specialism.
Balimo College of Nursing is a child safe organisation committed to the protection of people we serve. Our recruitment and selection procedures are designed to ensure we only recruit people who are suitable and aligned with our policies that ensure the safety of children and protection of all from sexual exploitation, abuse and harassment. All appointments are subject to appropriate background checks and screening and the successful candidate will be required to get a Working with Children check and/or a Police Certificate. We promote diversity and equality in all our practices and strongly encourage those with diverse backgrounds and/or disabilities to apply for positions with Balimo College School of Nursing.
WHAT WE OFFER:
A competitive remuneration package
Relocation costs to Balimo
Employee benefits in line with our Employee Benefits Policy
HOW TO APPLY
We encourage you to apply early. We are reviewing applications on a rolling basis. Qualified candidate will be contacted for an interview. The position will remain open until it is filled.
Apply via email to
[email protected]
with the following documents attached:
A cover letter addressing the following:
Your interest in the position of Tutor – Balimo College – School of Teaching
Your teaching philosophy
Your leadership philosophy
Your current resume
A copy of your Bachelor’s Degree (required)
A copy of your Master’s Degree (required)
At least one written reference
Apply

25337.description:
About Newmont
At Newmont, we’re not just a world-leading gold and metals producer – we’re a team united by our commitment to shaping a more inclusive, sustainable, and responsible mining industry. Joining us means becoming part of a global, diverse workforce where everyone is valued, empowered, and encouraged to grow. Our people are the heart of our success, bringing exceptional skill, integrity, and dedication to everything we do as an organization and we’re dedicated to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive.
About Lihir
Our Lihir Operation, located on the beautiful island of Niolam, approximately 800km north of Papua New Guinea's capital, Port Moresby, is one of the world’s largest gold mines. Set within a geothermically active, extinct volcanic crater, Lihir operates an open-pit mine producing refractory ore, which undergoes pressure oxidation and conventional leaching to recover gold. Our workforce includes both residential and commute rosters, creating a diverse and dynamic team. Lihir offers a range of recreational facilities, including a gym, sports club, restaurant, bar, swimming pool, tennis and squash courts, and a 9-hole golf course. For those who enjoy the outdoors, the Lihir fishing and boating clubs provide access to pristine waters and beaches, while our onsite deli and café serve fresh local and imported produce, barista-made coffee, and freshly baked goods.
We are proud to work closely with the local Lihirian community and value its vibrant culture. Through initiatives like our School to Mine program, we offer meaningful employment, training, and development opportunities for Lihirian men and women, as well as scholarships and vocational apprenticeships. We also partner with the New Ireland Province to ensure economic benefits flow directly to the community, strengthening our commitment to sustainable development and positive local impact.
Your impact
As a Supervisor, Planning and Scheduling you’ll support the execution of maintenance planning activities, helping ensure efficient scheduling, resource coordination, and compliance with operational and safety standards. Your work will directly contribute to operational reliability and team development at the Lihir site.
As part of our team, you will
Assist in developing and executing maintenance plans aligned with operational goals
Coordinate personnel, equipment, and materials for effective maintenance
Monitor asset performance and track KPIs to support improvement initiatives
Ensure compliance with health, safety, environmental, and regulatory standards
Conduct reliability checks and support root cause analysis
Implement preventive maintenance programs
Use predictive maintenance tools under guidance
Compile and submit reports on maintenance activities
Support budget monitoring and report variances
Contribute to team development through feedback, coaching, and training
Prerequisites for your success in this role
Trade qualification or relevant technical background is highly regarded
Solid understanding of maintenance planning and reliability principles
Proven track record in effectively managing maintenance planning and scheduling processes
Familiarity with safety and regulatory requirements
Experience in building team capabilities and providing leadership in change management
Basic proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook)
Proficient in relevant planning and scheduling systems and tools (SAP and FRM systems)
Strong attention to detail and administrative skills
Effective communication and collaboration skills
Commitment to Newmont’s values and operational goals
Your work environment
You’ll be part of the Fixed Plant Maintenance team at the Lihir site, leading 8–10 direct reports. You’ll collaborate with internal teams like Asset Management, Maintenance Execution, Supply Chain, Health & Safety, Reliability Engineering, and Finance, as well as external partners such as OEMs, contractors, government agencies, and community representatives. The environment is inclusive and safety-focused, with a strong emphasis on team development and open communication. You’ll also enjoy a family-friendly 21:21 roster, designed to support your work-life balance.
Why Join Newmont
Newmont offers a supportive, inclusive, and safety-driven culture where your contributions are valued. You’ll have opportunities for professional growth, team development, and the chance to make a meaningful impact on operational reliability and safety at one of the world’s leading mining companies.
At Newmont, our commitment to diversity and inclusion ensures that everyone can work to their full potential, free from discrimination, while respecting the cultures, religions, and governance of the regions in which we operate. Guided by our values of Safety, Integrity, Sustainability, Responsibility, and Inclusion, our Lihir team – 90% of which are Papua New Guinean – is dedicated to creating a culturally rich and supportive environment where meaningful, long-term connections can be formed within the industry.
We believe in the strength of our people and the positive impact we can create together. Newmont employees are rewarded with a competitive salary, flexible packaging options, and programs that recognize those who go above and beyond. We know no candidate meets every qualification listed, so if you share our values and feel you can make a meaningful contribution, we encourage you to apply before the closing date: 18 December 2025– we’d love to hear from you!
Apply

Audit & Assurance - Port Moresby, NCD
Organizational Context:
The Institute of Business Studies (IBS), from its’ humble beginning in 1987 as an arm of Nades & Associates primarily providing revision classes for the needs of Papua New Guinea Institute of Accountants (now CPA PNG), has evolved into a private University level Institution over the last 38 years. Today we are one of the largest business schools in the country and off degree programmes in the fields of Accounting & Finance, Business & Management, Economics & Development Studies and Information Technology. We also continue to provide study pathways for grade 10 & 12 school leavers including industry accreditations for those seasoned professionals who want to get certified in their field.

At IBS we believe that everyone has been gifted with natural talents and learnt skills. Career progression is also important to us and believes that each employee should be at the driving seat of their career progression - this means your manager will discuss with you where you want to be in the future and be more of a coach for you in terms of giving you feedback on areas you need to work on to be your best and achieve your goals. We also have a lot of staff events that enable us to celebrate as a team and give recognition where it's due.

Independently executing test cases, identifying and reporting defects, participating in requirement analysis, and contributing to test plans.

Execute test cases and audit checklists as directed.
Identify and report defects, non-compliance issues, and areas for improvement.
Contribute to the analysis of requirements for QA assessments.
Assist in documenting audit findings and reports.
Qualifications
A degree or equivalent in the relevant discipline.
Six Months to One Year Experience in Risk Management, Auditing, Compliance, Education Administration, or any similar relevant field.

Upward movement to Quality Assurance Officer (Level 3) shall take place after 1-2 years of experience, based on performance and demonstrated proficiency.

25327.description:
Don’t come for an easy career. Stay for a rewarding one.
Santos is a global energy company committed to increasingly cleaner energy and fuels production, with operations across Australia, Papua New Guinea, Timor-Leste and North America.
We are currently PNG’s largest single investor and most active explorer, operating all the country’s producing oil fields and holding an extensive appraisal and exploration portfolio. Our aspirations and strategies reflect our genuine commitment to making a meaningful contribution to the lives of Papua New Guineans.
At Santos, our commitment is to be a global leader in the transition to cleaner energy and clean fuels, by helping the world decarbonise to reach net-zero emissions in an affordable and sustainable way.
Santos is one of Australia’s biggest domestic gas supplier, a leading Asia Pacific LNG supplier and is committed to supplying the critical fuels such as oil and gas in a more sustainable way through decarbonising projects such as the Moomba CCS project.
For more than 65 years, Santos has been working in partnership with local communities, providing local jobs and business opportunities, safely and sustainably developing its natural gas resources, and powering industries and households.
What you’ll do:
Based in Moro, Southern Highlands Province, you will serve as the Team Leader – Aviation, supporting the Manager Aviation, EA, and PNG, while working closely with the management of Santos’ Aviation Operations in PNG.
In this role, you will be responsible for:
Fixed-wing and rotary-wing operations, including charter, company-owned aircraft, and regular public transport.
Aerodrome and helicopter landing site operations
Emergency response (ER) and Search and Rescue (SAR) capabilities
Security flights coordination
Reporting and compliance in alignment with company values and the Santos Management System.
This is a FIFO position offered on a 28/28 roster. We are open to expatriate applications with a point of hire Brisbane airport.
Key Accountabilities:
Assist in identifying, assessing, and monitoring aviation-related risks across Papua New Guinea operations.
Manage and support implementation of risk control measures and continuous improvement initiatives.
Provide coaching and mentoring to Papua New Guinean teams to support safe and efficient operations.
Assist with oversight of regional aviation activities, including helicopter operations, aerodrome and heli-base management, fixed-wing charter, and Regular Public Transport (RPT) services.
Support the establishment and coordination of Level 1 and Level 2 assurance activities and compliance programs.
Monitor contractor performance against service level agreements and contract scopes.
Support the Aviation Manager EA/PNG with designing and optimising aviation solutions and developing aviation contracting and commercial strategies
Provide aviation subject matter input during major incident and emergency response scenarios.
What you’ll bring:
Your proven experience in aviation operations including onshore/offshore aviation support, Emergency response and SAR, CASA key personnel responsibilities under AOC/MRO frameworks are essential.
You will have knowledge of Civil Aviation Safety Regulations, IOGP standards, IATA/ICAO frameworks, SMS, risk assessment, incident investigation, and operational auditing.
Your ability to travel domestically and internationally, including remote locations is required and you must meet CASA “fit and proper person” criteria.
Ideally you will also have:
Experience managing aviation operations in remote or complex environments
Aviation safety, quality, and risk management experience
Involvement in fixed-wing charter or multi-modal logistics planning
Knowledge of RPAS integration
Degree or diploma in aviation, engineering, or safety (or equivalent)
LAME or ATPL license
Certified or trained safety/aviation auditor (ISO 9001)
Certified or trained safety/aviation investigator (ICAM, NTSB)
What you’ll get:
Here, you’ll be amongst high-calibre people and get to work on industry-leading projects. We don’t shy away from solving tough problems at pace. We like it that way. You can expect to be challenged and supported; to learn and grow.
At Santos, we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive. This means a place that is safe; where you are valued and respected, and your contribution is recognised and appreciated. Join us, and you’ll play a role in this too.
Each of our sites offer access to specific amenities that aim to create the best possible benefits to your health, wellbeing and performance.
Everywhere you turn you will be a part of a team who are coming together to contribute to our single uniting purpose - to provide reliable and affordable energy to help create a better world for everyone And because it’s not only what you do, but how you do it, you will also contribute to improving the living standards of the communities where we operate, building enduring and respectful relationships that serve a generation. It’s about each of us, and all of us – together.
What you’re part of:
Everywhere you turn you will be a part of a team who are coming together to contribute to our single uniting purpose - to provide reliable and affordable energy to help create a better world for everyone And because it’s not only what you do, but how you do it, you will also contribute to improving the living standards of the communities where we operate, building enduring and respectful relationships that serve a generation. It’s about each of us, and all of us – together.
How to Apply
Applications must be submitted via the online recruitment system before
COB 16th December 2025.
Potential Scams
There are a number of fake adverts that are impersonating Santos Limited, in these instances you will receive an e-mail from a generic e-mail address. We do not make offers without interviews or due diligence taking place. You will know if an advert is genuine if you are directed to the Santos company careers page to apply which is
https://recruitment.santos.com/

25321.description:
At Newmont, we’re not just a world-leading gold and metals producer – we’re a team united by our commitment to shaping a more inclusive, sustainable, and responsible mining industry. Joining us means becoming part of a global, diverse workforce where everyone is valued, empowered, and encouraged to grow. Our people are the heart of our success, bringing exceptional skill, integrity, and dedication to everything we do as an organization and we’re dedicated to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive.
About Lihir
Our Lihir Operation, located on the beautiful island of Niolam, approximately 800km north of Papua New Guinea's capital, Port Moresby, is one of the world’s largest gold mines. Set within a geothermically active, extinct volcanic crater, Lihir operates an open-pit mine producing refractory ore, which undergoes pressure oxidation and conventional leaching to recover gold. Our workforce includes both residential and commute rosters, creating a diverse and dynamic team. Lihir offers a range of recreational facilities, including a gym, sports club, restaurant, bar, swimming pool, tennis and squash courts, and a 9-hole golf course. For those who enjoy the outdoors, the Lihir fishing and boating clubs provide access to pristine waters and beaches, while our onsite deli and café serve fresh local and imported produce, barista-made coffee, and freshly baked goods.
We are proud to work closely with the local Lihirian community and value its vibrant culture. Through initiatives like our School to Mine program, we offer meaningful employment, training, and development opportunities for Lihirian men and women, as well as scholarships and vocational apprenticeships. We also partner with the New Ireland Province to ensure economic benefits flow directly to the community, strengthening our commitment to sustainable development and positive local impact.
Your Impact
You will play a key role in ensuring a safe and healthy work environment by conducting field inspections, safety audits, and incident investigations. Your efforts will directly support operational leaders in identifying and managing safety risks, helping to eliminate workplace injuries and illnesses.
As Part of Our Team, You Will
Monitor field activities and conduct safety audits to identify hazards and ensure compliance.
Deliver hands-on safety coaching and training to site personnel.
Implement safety protocols and procedures tailored to on-site conditions.
Support and contribute to safety programs, including fatality and incident management, injury reduction, and health & wellbeing initiatives.
Assist in executing the site-based Health & Safety plan.
Influence and support frontline leaders in safe work execution.
Coordinate OHS Representative programs and operationalize safety management systems.
Support assurance programs for Health & Safety standards and processes.
Prerequisites for Your Success in This Role
Knowledge of industry-recognized health & safety systems, standards, and regulations (e.g., OSHA, MSHA).
Experience with safety investigations, risk assessment, and change management.
Competency in implementing health & safety systems and standards.
Foundational skills in project management, data analysis, and commercial processes (budgets, planning, reporting).
Strong communication, influencing, and collaboration skills.
Self-awareness and a commitment to continuous improvement and team success.
Your Work Environment
You’ll be part of the Safety & Sustainability team, working closely with operational supervisors, H&S peers, and site personnel. The role is field-based on a 21:21 roster, requiring hands-on engagement and collaboration across disciplines to maintain a safe and productive workplace.
Why Join Newmont
At Newmont, you’ll contribute to a culture that values safety, teamwork, and continuous improvement. You’ll have opportunities to develop your skills, make a meaningful impact, and be part of a diverse and supportive team committed to excellence in health and safety.
At Newmont, our commitment to diversity and inclusion ensures that everyone can work to their full potential, free from discrimination, while respecting the cultures, religions, and governance of the regions in which we operate. Guided by our values of Safety, Integrity, Sustainability, Responsibility, and Inclusion, our Lihir team – 90% of which are Papua New Guinean – is dedicated to creating a culturally rich and supportive environment where meaningful, long-term connections can be formed within the industry.
We believe in the strength of our people and the positive impact we can create together. Newmont employees are rewarded with a competitive salary, flexible packaging options, and programs that recognize those who go above and beyond. We know no candidate meets every qualification listed, so if you share our values and feel you can make a meaningful contribution, we encourage you to apply before the closing date: 16 December 2025 – we’d love to hear from you!
Apply

25332.description:
Don’t come for an easy career. Stay for a rewarding one.
Santos is a global energy company committed to increasingly cleaner energy and fuels production, with operations across Australia, Papua New Guinea, Timor-Leste and North America.
We are currently PNG’s largest single investor and most active explorer, operating all the country’s producing oil fields and holding an extensive appraisal and exploration portfolio. Our aspirations and strategies reflect our genuine commitment to making a meaningful contribution to the lives of Papua New Guineans.
At Santos, our commitment is to be a global leader in the transition to cleaner energy and clean fuels, by helping the world decarbonise to reach net-zero emissions in an affordable and sustainable way.
Santos is one of Australia’s biggest domestic gas supplier, a leading Asia Pacific LNG supplier and is committed to supplying the critical fuels such as oil and gas in a more sustainable way through decarbonising projects such as the Moomba CCS project.
For more than 65 years, Santos has been working in partnership with local communities, providing local jobs and business opportunities, safely and sustainably developing its natural gas resources, and powering industries and households.
What you’ll do:
Based in Papua New Guinea, on a 4 and 4 roster the Mechanical Trainer will provide hands-on training, support, and assessment for Maintenance Staff, Mechanical Apprentices, and trainees. You’ll help them safely and efficiently build the skills and confidence needed to perform their roles effectively, adding real value to the Production and Maintenance teams.
Key Responsibilities:
Deliver hands-on mechanical training and assessments in line with the Competency Based Training (CBT) program and company standards.
Collaborate with the Operations Training Team Lead, Maintenance Teams, and stakeholders to design training strategies, approaches, plans, and materials, ensuring the most effective tools and applications are available to assess and train mechanical trainees to the required standards.
Prepare plans and organise schedules for assessments and training according to CBT program requirements and Maintenance Team needs.
Collaborate with the Operations Readiness and Assurance Manager, Operations Training Team Lead, peers, and others to evaluate the assessment and training process, providing feedback to continually improve the CBT program.
Role models the value of Always Safe and actively promote Health, Safety, Environment, and Security policies.
Maintain accurate training and assessment records, ensuring timely updates in relevant systems.
Develop and deliver training resources as needed.
Ensure compliance with the Santos Management System (SMS), Delegation of Authority (DOA), and corporate governance and safety standards.
What you’ll bring:
Essential
Extensive experience spanning over a decade in Oil & Gas Operations.
Proven and significant experience in training, lead or supervisory role.
Demonstrated maintenance expertise
Proven track record in delivering effective training
Proficient in MS Excel, Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint
Strong attention to detail
Takes ownership of assignments from start to finish, reporting progress and challenges.
Exercises sound judgement and discretion on confidential matters.
Strong time management and administrative abilities.
Ability to prioritise workload, stay organised, and think quickly.
Adaptable able to adjust priorities as the Training Department role demands change.
Trade qualified (Mechanical).
Accreditation in Training and Assessing TAE40116 or TAE40122.
Desirable
Experience interacting with Senior Management personnel.
Proficiency with ERP software or online data entry systems (e.g., SAP).
What you’ll get:
Here, you’ll be amongst high-calibre people and get to work on industry-leading projects. We don’t shy away from solving tough problems at pace. We like it that way. You can expect to be challenged and supported; to learn and grow.
At Santos, we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive. This means a place that is safe; where you are valued and respected, and your contribution is recognised and appreciated. Join us, and you’ll play a role in this too.
Each of our sites offer access to specific amenities that aim to create the best possible benefits to your health, wellbeing and performance.
Everywhere you turn you will be a part of a team who are coming together to contribute to our single uniting purpose - to provide reliable and affordable energy to help create a better world for everyone And because it’s not only what you do, but how you do it, you will also contribute to improving the living standards of the communities where we operate, building enduring and respectful relationships that serve a generation. It’s about each of us, and all of us – together.
What you’re part of:
Everywhere you turn you will be a part of a team who are coming together to contribute to our single uniting purpose - to provide reliable and affordable energy to help create a better world for everyone And because it’s not only what you do, but how you do it, you will also contribute to improving the living standards of the communities where we operate, building enduring and respectful relationships that serve a generation. It’s about each of us, and all of us – together.
How to Apply
Applications must be submitted via the online recruitment system before
COB 16th December 2025.
A requirement of this role is that you will need to have in place the legal work rights for PNG to apply.
Potential Scams
There are a number of fake adverts that are impersonating Santos Limited, in these instances you will receive an e-mail from a generic e-mail address. We do not make offers without interviews or due diligence taking place. You will know if an advert is genuine if you are directed to the Santos company careers page to apply which is
https://recruitment.santos.com/
Apply

Lae Occupational Health Safety Environment & Quality
 
Supervisor


Location: Lae, Morobe Province


Responsibilities:


OHSEQ Duties
:




Report to OHSEQ Manager 


Heading all OHSEQ roles and duties to ensure Company Safety Policies and Procedures are efficiently implemented in all Company sites.


Having monthly meetings with Management concerning branch Safety issues and improvement.


Compiling and lodging insurance claim for Comprehensive & TPO claims to Insurer.


Heavily involved in dealing with Third Parties Motor Vehicle Accident (MVA) cases and resolve them amicably. 


Compiling Insurance claims summary to Financial Controller and management, having regular meetings and updating.


Attend to all MVA accident/incident cases and do ICAM investigation analysis report.


Representing Company and attend all MVA court cases at Traffic court, District Court and Civil court/National Court.


Coaching and training OHSEQ Coordinator, Safety officers to upskill with the Safety Health, Environment & Quality function on day-to-day operations of the OHSEQ department.


Making sure safety officers, traffic controllers and other Safety reps to report all Safety issues and non-compliances behaviours to OHSEQ and Business Units.


Conducting monthly OHSEQ meetings with Safety officers and departmental Safety representatives to address branch Safety issues.


Ensure OHSEQ WHS yearly calendar objectives are implemented through all branches Lae, Pom & Honiara.


Conducting Risk Assessment and identifying potential risks and hazards in workplaces/sites thus develop new SOPs to Management for endorsement and implementation.


Conducting Route Risk Assessment (RRA) for existing highways and new roads and implement Company authorised speed limit geo-fencing with Master Systems to mitigate risks of accidents/incidents.


Conducting F2F and Zoom meetings with clients on Safety issues arises in Company operations.


Having regular meetings with respective Business Unit Managers and addressing their Safety issues confronting them in their operations.


Mandated to resolve and manage safety issues and complaints courteously and efficiently.


Conducting internal and external audits to meet requirements and achieve higher Standard. 


Making sure Safety department staff conducting random alcohol breathalyser test daily and on suspicious occasions and provide report to each Business Unit Managers.


Step up and provide assistance/advices to all departmental safety issues with OHSEQ representative and Business Unit managers at respective BUs.


Responsible for conducting quarterly workplaces risk assessments and implement management planning to control and mitigate risks and hazards on-sites.


Conducting drivers cargo latching and unlatching and fork lift/reach stacker operators safety evaluation assessment.


Assist Training department and promote defensives driving and make awareness to new and upcoming drivers and all in respective BU’s Tool-Box-Talk. Continually focused on Safety awareness 
(Take 5 approach = Stop-Think-Identify-Plan-Proceed)
.


Conducting new staff induction and site induction for contractors.


Overseeing OHS Coordinator and Safety officers conducting JSERA for review and issue of Work Permit/Permit To Work (PTW).


Responsible in organising sixth monthly service of all fire equipment (fire extinguisher, fire hose, fire hydrant, smoke detectors & etc) in Lae branch.


Responsible for conducting yearly Emergency Fire Drill and compile report to Management for Audit purposes.


Overseeing all Compliance licenses from Government Regulatory Departments for annual renewals.


Responsible in ordering annual Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) from Dunlop PNG for branch and assisting other branches for their PPE orders.


Always dress in company uniform and appropriate PPE, take pride in your appearance and that of your teams.


Responsible in providing advices to Company Safety Strategic Development plan and Strategy endorsement by Company Management.


Taking Lead in advocating and promoting accident/incident FREE month/year attitude.


Responsible for compiling Lae branch monthly OHSEQ Performance Analysis Report to Management and All for improvement and Compliance.


Mandated to overseeing ALL Staff, Supervisors, Managers and Management to 100% adhere to all Company Safety Policies and Compliance.


Be a role model to all staff on all Safety aspects and Company Policies.


Fly high with 
YES,
 
WE CAN!
 Attitude.


Obliged to have a Zero tolerance and report non-adherence to Company Policies or fraudulent activates.




DG Ops Function & Duties
:




Overseeing all DG operations and training and mentoring DG Ops Coordinator to his function.


Arranging DG monthly ops meetings with ops team and special Management meetings.


Ensuring all DG Customer objectives are achieved in accordance with their plans.


Overseeing DG Class 1/Explosives Police Clearance are prepared and lodged in time for Police Metropolitan Superintendent to endorse.


Ensure Safety team must conduct pre-departure checks for all DG trucks prior to commence DG tasks.  






Liaise with Export team for DGs (Explosives/AN/ANE/Cyanide) are booked and handled properly with DG drivers to wharves.


Follow up with Import team for DGs (Explosives/AN/ANE/Cyanide) shipment ETA, Clearance and gate passes for Transport DG drivers to cart to its destination safely.


Training and mentoring DG ops admin to facilitate all DG documents in timely manner.


Providing Transport and Logistics advice to DG ops team for smooth operations.


Ensure all DG ops dockets and invoices are charged accordingly to clients.




MUST HAVE:




Qualification OHS officer level 1- 4 or preferred OHS Diploma.


Possess valid driving licence class 3, 6 or 4


Good on Excel spreadsheet, MS Microsoft & PowerPoint presentation




Submit your applications to
 
[email protected]


Note: Applicants with minimum 5 years experince in OHSEQ will be consirdered. If you do not have minimum 5 years of exeprince and do not fit above criteria, those applications will be ignored.

Holiday Inn & Suites Port Moresby
Holiday Inn Express Port Moresby
At Holiday Inn, we’re all about making travel easier and more enjoyable for our guests — and that starts with the people who bring our brand to life. If you’re a relationship-builder, a natural connector, and someone who loves driving commercial results while keeping things genuine and human, we’d love to meet you.
The Opportunity
We’re looking for an experienced Senior Sales Manager to join our Commercial Team in Port Moresby, supporting both Holiday Inn & Suites and Holiday Inn Express. In this portfolio role, you’ll develop strong partnerships, unlock new business opportunities, and lead the charge in growing our market share across key segments.
You’ll report directly to the Portfolio Director of Sales & Marketing and play a key role in shaping the commercial success of our two hotels.
What You’ll Do
Lead sales activity across key corporate, government, group, and long-stay segments
Build meaningful client relationships that feel like family — the Holiday Inn way
Create smart sales strategies that drive revenue, grow share, and strengthen the brand
Support the development of proactive and reactive sales structures

Mentor and support junior team members as we grow the next generation of IHG talent
What We’re Looking For
Proven hotel sales experience, ideally within an international brand
Strong communication and presentation skills
A proactive, positive, can-do approach
Ability to build trust quickly and maintain long-lasting partnerships
Commercially savvy, organised, and comfortable managing a fast-moving portfolio
Someone who embodies the Holiday Inn spirit – warm, open, and genuinely helpful

3-5 years hotel experience (international brand preferred)
Strong experience with government, corporate, or mining accounts.
Proven ability to meet revenue targets and manage key accounts.
Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
Understanding of Port Moresby market dynamics.

25308.description:
Our People and Culture team is growing! We're looking for a dynamic and detail-oriented
People & Culture Officer
with a specialization in Remuneration and Benefits to join us in Port Moresby.
The
P&C Officer (Talent Acquisition)
will be responsible for managing and overseeing the recruitment process. This includes sourcing, interviewing, and hiring candidates for various roles, with an emphasis on finding top-tier talent to align with the company's goals and culture. The position will involve working closely with Business Partners to understand staffing needs and develop recruitment strategies. The role is based in Port Moresby.
Key Responsibilities
Recruitment Strategy
:
Execute recruitment strategies to attract a diverse pool of qualified candidates. Tailor approaches based on the Credit Corporation’s immediate needs and long-term hiring goals.
Candidate Sourcing
:
Utilise various platforms (job boards, social media, networking, employee referrals, etc.) to source active and passive candidates.
Job Postings
:
Write and post detailed, accurate job adverts and specifications across multiple channels.
Screening & Interviewing
:
Review CVs, conduct initial screening, and interview candidates. Use behavioural and competency-based interview techniques to assess applicants' skills, qualifications, and cultural fit.
Hiring Process Management
:
Coordinate all stages of the hiring process, including reference checks, negotiating job offers, and ensuring a smooth onboarding experience.
Collaboration
:
Work closely with BPs & hiring managers to ensure alignment on job requirements and applicant profiles.
Applicant Experience:
Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment process, providing feedback and maintaining communication from application to hire.
Talent Pool Development
:
Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified applicants for current and future job openings.
Employer Branding
:
Promote Credit Corporation as an employer of choice by showcasing its values, culture, and benefits to potential applicants.
Compliance & Reporting
:
Ensure recruitment practices are compliant with legal and regulatory standards. Track and report on recruitment metrics and the effectiveness of various sourcing methods.
Continuous Improvement
:
Stay current on recruitment trends and best practices, continuously optimizing the hiring process for efficiency and effectiveness.
Other duties
Other duties as directed by the Head of People & Culture and Talent Acquisition Manager.
Education & Experience
Qualifications:
Minimum of a Diploma in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.
HR certifications (e.g., PNGHRI) is an advantage.
Experience
:
Minimum of 3-5 years of HR experience.
Strong background in the talent acquisition space.
Skills & Competencies
:
Highly attentive to details
Always ensures accountability
Collaborates well with stakeholders at all levels
Communicates effectively
Is Customer focused ensuring all TA objective tick efficient people management objectives
Optimises work processes always looking to improve
Ability to think strategically, while managing day-to day operational tasks
Proficient in Microsoft Officer Suite and other P&C software applications
Strong problem-solving skills and results driven mind-set
Knowledge of current HR trends, employment laws and best practices.

25283.description:
Position: Senior Radio Technician
Location: Port Moresby
Employment Type: Full-time
Overview:
TE (PNG) Ltd is seeking an experienced Senior Radio Technician responsible for advanced diagnostics, programming, repair, testing, and calibration of two-way radio communication equipment. The role requires demonstrated capability working with Icom, Tait, and Motorola radios, covering both analogue and digital platforms (DMR, IDAS, where applicable). This position plays a key role in ensuring high-quality technical output, supporting customer service expectations, and maintaining TE PNG’s reputation as the local leader in professional communications services. The technician will also contribute to process improvements, workshop standards, and knowledge sharing within the technical team.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Radio Diagnostics & Repair
Perform fault finding, repair and refurbishment of portable, mobile and repeater radio equipment.
Conduct component-level repairs including soldering, RF board diagnostics, and rework.
Load, program and optimise radio codeplugs, channels, zones, and network features.
Interpret radio schematics, service manuals, and alignment procedures.
Conduct RF testing including power output, deviation, modulation, SINAD, BER and VSWR.
Complete firmware updates, feature activation and calibration to manufacturer standards.
Quality & Compliance
Verify programming, audio quality, RF performance and reliability before release.
Maintain documentation for repair findings, parts used, and test results.
Support warranty assessments for Icom, Tait, and Motorola product lines.
Monitor recurring issues and recommend preventive actions or design improvements.
Workshop Coordination
Ensure timely completion of repair tasks with accurate status tracking in the service system.
Assist customer service with repair quotations and equipment assessments.
Liaise with warehouse and procurement for parts availability and replenishment.
Technical Support & Communication
Provide guidance to customers and internal teams on radio functionality and configuration.
Support field technicians when advanced bench-level assistance is required.
Occasionally communicate directly with key customers on complex technical matters.
Tools, Equipment & Safety
Maintain all test equipment such as service monitors, RF analysers and programming tools.
Ensure calibration is current and maintain clean, organised work areas.
Follow workshop safety procedures including ESD and PPE requirements.
Continuous Improvement
Stay current with new radio models, digital protocols and diagnostic technologies.
Contribute to workshop knowledge sharing and technical training activities.
Recommend workflow and process improvements to increase efficiency and quality.
SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS
Minimum Requirements
Diploma, or Degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, IT Hardware, or related field.
5+ years of experience in radio installation, diagnostics and repair.
Strong skills in soldering, rework, testing, and component-level troubleshooting.
Ability to read schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation.
Proficiency in using oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, function generators, or other diagnostic instruments.
Strong attention to detail with a quality-focused mindset.
Analytical thinker with excellent problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a technical team.
Good communication skills and willingness to mentor others.
Highly organised, reliable, and capable of managing multiple priorities
BENEFITS:
Competitive salary based on experience
Medical Insurance Cover
Ongoing training and professional development opportunities
HOW TO APPLY
Interested candidates are invited to submit their Letter of Interest, Updated Resume and Supporting Documents outlining how their qualifications and experience meet the responsibilities and qualifications requirements. All documents to be compiled and sent on one PDF file format to TE (PNG) Human Resources email address:
[email protected]
before close of business on
Friday, 12
th
December 2025
. Please include
"Senior Bench Technician - Port Moresby"
in the subject line of your email.
Apply

25185.description:
Building healthy, resilient PNG communities.
Fund income benefits future generations.
Deliver impactful community programs.
The opportunity
PNG SDP drives long-term welfare improvement and community resilience in Papua New Guinea, primarily within Western Province, through strategic investments in health, education, and sustainable livelihoods.
The role
The Facilities Manager role is pivotal to this mission. You will drive PNG SDP 's continued success by ensuring the effective operation, maintenance, and safety of all infrastructure and facilities across all hubs. This includes guaranteeing full compliance with OHS and building regulations, conducting routine facility risk assessments, and implementing robust preventative maintenance schedules to enhance organizational resilience and operational continuity. This role requires extensive collaboration with internal departments, site managers, and external contractors to provide the well-managed, compliant, and functional physical environments necessary for smooth program delivery.
This is a perfect opportunity if you're a proactive, hands-on, and solutions-oriented professional with a background in Facilities Management, Construction, or Engineering, looking to leverage your expertise in demanding multi-site or remote settings. You will directly secure the safety and continuity of the critical infrastructure that empowers local communities.
Main duties include:
Oversee the daily operations and upkeep of all PNGSDP-managed facilities (accommodations, clinics, depots).
Implement and execute preventative and corrective maintenance schedules for essential infrastructure, including plumbing, electrical, HVAC, and generators.
Ensure all facilities adhere to occupational health and safety (OHS) and building regulations, including managing security, fire safety systems, and conducting risk assessments.
Plan, scope, and manage minor renovation or refurbishment projects, overseeing contractor engagement and quality control for facility improvements.
Prepare and manage the annual facilities budget, control utility usage for cost-effectiveness, and ensure facilities-related procurement follows compliance procedures.
Lead and manage assigned support staff (maintenance, guards) and serve as the key point of contact for external contractors and utility service providers.
Qualification and Experience:
Minimum 5–7 years managing facilities in a remote or multi-site setting, including WASH (Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene) experience.
Required Diploma/Bachelor's degree in Facilities Management, Construction, or Engineering.
Proven ability in preventive maintenance, asset management, budgeting, procurement, and contractor supervision.
Knowledge of PNG OHS/building codes, commitment to safety compliance, and a proactive, hands-on, culturally sensitive approach.
Strong computer skills and knowledge in MS Office, with proven knowledge in maintenance tracking software being an advantage.
Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, coupled with strong organisational and problem-solving skills.
High attention to detail and service quality.
Ability to manage teams and contractors across multiple remote locations.
Commitment to safety, accountability, and continuous improvement, while being culturally sensitive and respectful of local customs and community norms.
Experience in vendor management as part of procurement responsibilities and maintaining accurate records of fixed assets, buildings, and equipment.
If this role is the next step in your exciting career, please register your interest by clicking APPLY NOW and submitting your most recent CV in Microsoft Word format.

Your legacy is our business

25366.description:
Goodman Fielder Papua New Guinea is one of PNG’s largest food companies, manufacturing and distributing high-quality Flour, Stock Feed, Rice, Snacks, and Bakery products throughout the country. Well-known products and brands include Flame Flour, Flame Stockfeed, Flame Oil & Sugar, Flame Rice, Bilas Bread, Skel Rice, Twisties snacks, Arthurs Pies, and the Meadow Lea range.
At GFI, we care about making food better for everyone.
Our goal is to be the leading and most innovative food company with a mission to meet our customers’ needs for superior quality foods with brands that are trusted by families everywhere.  We are the go-to source of consumer, shopper, and customer insights to help our customer and business partners succeed.
We currently have an immediate vacancy for a Bakery Supervisor who will be responsible for overseeing daily bakery operations, ensuring production targets are met with consistent quality, safety, and efficiency. This role supports the team in delivering high-standard baked goods while maintaining compliance with food safety regulations and company policies.
Your responsiblities will include:
Production Oversight
Supervise day-to-day bakery operations, ensuring adherence to production schedules.
Monitor product quality, consistency, and compliance with recipes and standards.
Coordinate raw material usage and minimize wastage.
Team Leadership
Lead, train, and motivate bakery staff to achieve performance goals.
Manage shift rosters, attendance, and performance evaluations.
Foster a positive, safe, and collaborative work environment.
Quality & Compliance
Ensure strict compliance with HACCP, GMP, and food safety standards.
Conduct regular hygiene and safety checks across the bakery floor.
Report and resolve non-conformance issues promptly.
Operational Efficiency
Identify process improvements to enhance productivity and reduce costs.
Maintain accurate production records and reports.
Support continuous improvement initiatives within the bakery.
Health, Safety & Environment
Enforce PPE usage and workplace safety protocols.
Participate in safety audits and incident investigations.
Promote a culture of safety and accountability.
To be considered for the role, you will need to have:
Diploma or Certificate in Food Technology, Baking, or related discipline (preferred).
Minimum 2-3 years’ experience in bakery or food production supervision.
Strong knowledge of bakery processes, equipment, and food safety standards.
Proven leadership and team management skills.
Ability to work under pressure and meet production deadlines.
Be part of the Skel life and join a team that values healthy eating and active lifestyles and wants to share that with all the people of PNG.  Still interested? Send your letter of application and CV/resume with at least 2 referees to:

.

25295.description:
12 months fixed term contract, with possible extension
Based in Port Moresby
Join an NGO that’s human-first, impact-driven, and fun to work with
About Catalpa
At Catalpa, we’re all about creating real impact. We’re a global development organisation that believes bright ideas—mixed with technology, creativity, and local know-how—can solve tough challenges.
Our team is a mix of engineers, designers, educators, economists, and project delivery folk. Together, we work on projects that matter and actually change lives. One of the things we’re most proud of?  Making learning accessible and engaging for communities that are often left out.  Our work is meaningful, innovative, and, honestly, pretty cool. Check us out at
www.catalpa.io
About the position
We are picking up the pace with projects in PNG, and as Catalpa continues to grow, so does our appetite for awesome talent.
Right now, we are on the lookout for a Finance and Operations Coordinator. This role is central to the smooth, timely, and compliant delivery of Catalpa’s projects in Papua New Guinea.  You’ll be our PNG team problem solver and connector—providing essential day-to-day support across finance, administration, procurement, logistics, operations, and safety and security, and working closely with our project teams to keep our activities running efficiently.
In this role, the Coordinator will help maintain strong operational systems, ensure financial and procurement compliance, and contribute to the continual improvement of Catalpa’s processes. The position supports teams in planning and implementing activities, managing resources, and resolving operational challenges as they arise.  By providing reliable, responsive, and high-quality support, the Finance and Operations Coordinator helps ensure Catalpa’s PNG programs operate effectively and uphold organisational and donor requirements.
A detailed Terms of Reference for this position
can be found here
.
Requirements
We’d love to meet someone who has:
Minimum 3 years of experience in a finance and/or operations role, preferably within the international development or NGO context.
Relevant qualifications in management, administration, finance, HR, international development, or a related field.
Demonstrated knowledge and experience in supporting the day to day management of an office and team environment - supporting teams, meeting deadlines and achieving outputs.
You’ll be tech savvy and find it easy to learn IT systems such as Xero, Slack and Googlesuite.
Experience in a similar role where organising and prioritising tasks is a part of your everyday life.
Working knowledge of general office administration and logistics processes is essential.  You’ll have experience across these areas:
Day to day financial processes including accounts payable
Procurement and asset management
Logistics such as organising events, travel, liaising with suppliers, vehicle management, IT support
Being  a point of contact for safety and security support for staff
Knowledge of PNG labour, immigration, and payroll requirements.
A full PNG driver’s licence is essential!
We seek a self-driven, proactive and dynamic candidate with strong inter-personal and communication skills for building and maintaining relationships with teams, key stakeholders and service providers.
Extra awesome if you bring:
Strong financial management skills with experience using accounting systems (Xero desirable).
Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritise effectively, and meet deadlines under pressure.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across diverse teams.
Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
Strong problem-solving skills and a practical approach to challenges.
Eligibility
We love working with smart people from diverse backgrounds who are willing to learn new things. There are many skills we think this job will make use of but feel free to apply even if you’re not a ‘perfect fit’.
Work environment
We work in a creative, supportive environment with colleagues who come from diverse walks of life, and we value the perspectives they bring. We pay attention to the details, and we work together to achieve the best we can. Importantly, we work here because we love what we do and the impact we can have.
We know people’s lives include many obligations outside of work, so we aim to create a flexible work environment that includes remote work options, generous family leave, and return-to-work policies to support new parents. We know we do our best work when we take care of ourselves and communities. We take two weeks off at the end of each year to recharge and refresh.
Fit
Catalpa staff believe in the potential of technology to transform lives for the better. Our team members are flexible and can handle working across a broad range of responsibilities. They don’t mind rolling up their sleeves to solve thorny challenges that take time, patience, and creativity. We are friendly and care about the people with whom we work, always seeking to build and nurture relationships for the long-term.
Catalpa seeks to provide a fair and equal employment opportunity for all people, regardless of race, color, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, age, gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or marital status.
